name: patch
description: Apply a unified diff, a whole-file write, or a byte-exact unique str_replace to the workspace. str_replace requires path, old, and new; it never guesses near matches. Single action; do not emit parallel calls.

path.description: Primary file touched by the patch or write

content.description: Full file content for whole-file creation or overwrite

old.description: Exact unique preimage for action str_replace
